subject: Executive approval: GrandBridge first-responder pilot credits + discount request
messages:
From: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@grandbridgehealth.org>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karen Li <karen.li@grandbridgehealth.org>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: first-responder anonymized notes POC — credits + pricing ask

Sofia — thanks again for the demo last week. We had a strong internal showing from our EMS product team and the clinical ops folks. Two quick asks as we work to finalize a short pilot with our East Coast deployment team: 

1) Can Redwood extend the 30-day trial to 60 days for this pilot? The integration and redaction validation will need extra run-time.
2) Would you consider a one-time credit of $15k and a 20% promotional discount on usage for the pilot month? That gets us through validation and makes the internal business case straightforward.

We have a security questionnaire underway (I copied contracts). If there's anything from your side to speed the SOC evidence, let me know.

Attachment: GrandBridge_pilot_requirements.docx (attachment stub)

—Daniel Ortiz
Program Lead, Digital Product
GrandBridge Health
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@grandbridgehealth.org>, Karen Li <karen.li@grandbridgehealth.org>, contracts@grandbridgehealth.org
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request: first-responder anonymized notes POC — credits + pricing ask

Team — forwarding GrandBridge's ask. Summary: 60-day trial extension, $15k one-time credit, and 20% pilot-month usage discount. They are a strategic public-health-oriented account (large municipal EMS partner) — win here helps our public-sector positioning.

Quick context and numbers (see attached spreadsheet):
- Expected pilot usage: ~3M tokens/day peak, ~40M tokens total for 60 days
- Current estimate of gross cost to us: ~ $28k (unquantized GPU + infra)
- Proposed concession: $15k credit + 20% rebate on billed usage for pilot = net concession estimate ~$19k

Requested ask to leadership: expedited exec approval for combined credit + promo discount as an exception to standard 30d/10k credit policy. If approved, I'll send SOW stub and DocuSign link to contracts.

Attachments: grandbridge_pilot_credit_plan.xlsx (attachment)

Questions for you:
- Marissa: do we have precedent for this stacked concession for public-sector nonprofit customers?
- Jonas: finance input on margin impact and whether we should ask for minimal commit/credit capture in a follow-up PO?
- Aditya: can you weigh in on exec-level signoff or whether this needs VP signoff?

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@grandbridgehealth.org>, contracts@grandbridgehealth.org
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request: first-responder anonymized notes POC — credits + pricing ask

Sofia / Jonas / Aditya — I like this opportunity and the strategic upside. My read: offer the 60-day extension + $12.5k one-time credit (instead of $15k) and a 15% promo discount for the pilot month, contingent on a signed SOW + PO capturing the pilot scope and a short follow-up commit conversation (30-day sales review). Rationale: protects margin while giving enough runway for them to validate.

If we want to be more aggressive, I can approve the full $15k credit but I'd need Aditya's sign-off for the higher concession. Jonas — confirm we can book the $12.5k as marketing rebate vs direct revenue reduction (preferred) so it doesn't impact committed capacity calculations.

Suggested language for exec note (short):
- Approve 60-day pilot extension and one-time credit of $12,500 plus 15% usage discount for pilot month for GrandBridge Health (GB-2028-47-PILOT). Contingent on SOW + PO within 7 days.

Please reply with quick +1 / -1 / ask for escalate. Time sensitive — they want DocuSign this week.

—Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@grandbridgehealth.org>, contracts@grandbridgehealth.org
Date: Tue, 19 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request: first-responder anonymized notes POC — credits + pricing ask

+1 from me on Marissa's recommendation. Approve 60-day trial extension, $12,500 one-time credit, and 15% usage discount for the pilot month for GrandBridge Health (deal GB-2028-47-PILOT).

Conditions:
- SOW and PO executed in 7 business days and deal owner (Sofia) to capture the outcome in HubSpot (linked).
- Contracts to include standard SOC evidence exchange clause before production data is used; if they need earlier access, source-controlled key escrow required.

Sofia — please send the approved SOW + DocuSign link to Daniel and loop contracts for signature. Jonas — finance, please route rebate booking as marketing rebate if possible and confirm impact by EOD Thu.

Thanks — Aditya
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
